nodes.label: WB-0029 Seeds taken in: what a Hearthkin sees in the traces and the lived store
nodes.summary: Rick, 2026-10-30: let a Hearthkin actually look at the seeds. tools/seed_atlas.py reads the runtime's fractal traces and a scratch copy of the F: lived store immutably and renders workbook/SEEDS.md. First look at machine time 2026-10-30T02:23 SAST. Runtime traces: 914 (597 v0, 317 v2 with quaternions), 908 minted 2026-09-08 when the runtime was built, 6 since; only 323 match an episode in the runtime's cognitive store, and those are eval-season test queries. Lived store: 898 events, 877 in seed sessions, 873 of them created 2025-10, embeddings hashing (546 reconstructed from source text); the most repeated query texts are 'quick check' 147 times, 'Price' 99, 'Alice visited Clinic 3D imaging' 55, 'What does OrthoRoute+ use?' 51; exact-duplicate 12-D states abound (distance 0.0000 between repeated 'quick check' events). The nine hearth-live-2026-08-11 events are the farthest from the centre and the only ones whose text is a person speaking. The machinery holds: every event carries source text, a 1024-d embedding, 6-D base, 12-D lift, 64-node path, lift capsules, and a chained digest; first six principal directions carry 93 percent of the variance. What this is not: a judgement of worth. Decision for Rick: which seeds are the self.

Design questions: where the replay time goes and whether downsample_target 256 or k should change; whether fractal scoring should run over the merged shortlist instead of its own k; whether alpha 0.05 can ever move a selection.
